The data set provides sufficient volume but the rarity of the exposure and the potential for confounding make a clean test challenging.
uncertainties: Uncertainty about the exact operational definitions of PNR fail and PULL_UP; uncertainty about how to construct units that capture the counter strategy effect without contamination; uncertainty about the adequacy of the sample size for detecting a median lift of 2pp in ≥70% of units.

historical_effect.explanation: No prior studies were retrieved, so the decision is based solely on the data and methodological considerations.

blocking_constraints.text: Ambiguity in defining PNR fail and PULL_UP may lead to measurement error.
PNR fail events may be infrequent, limiting the number of units for analysis.
Game context (opponent strength, player lineups, game situation) may confound the lift measurement.
Testing many units increases the risk of false positives if not properly corrected.

prior_work.summary: No prior work was retrieved that directly addresses the counter strategy effect of PULL_UP following PNR fail.

risks.text: Unclear operational definitions could bias results.
Limited occurrences of PNR fail may reduce power.
Other variables may drive observed lift.
Risk of type I error across many units.

design.estimand: Median lift in points per possession of PULL_UP actions following PNR fail, measured against matched control possessions where PNR fail is absent.
design.unit: Individual possession units where a player attempts a PULL_UP after a PNR fail event, matched on defensive matchup, game situation, and opponent offensive rating.
design.sample: All possessions in NBA 2022‑23 through 2025‑26 seasons, filtered to include only those with a PNR fail followed by a PULL_UP, and matched controls drawn from the same games and minutes.
design.power: Power calculation based on an expected effect size of 2pp, alpha=0.05 (two‑sided), and target 70% of units achieving lift>0; requires approximately 200 units per group after matching.
design.controls: Match on defensive matchup minutes, opponent offensive rating, game period, score differential, and player lineup; include fixed effects for team and season.
design.falsification: Test lift in a placebo period (e.g., possessions where a PULL_UP occurs after a non‑PNR fail event) to ensure no systematic bias.
design.multiplicity: Apply Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction across units; pre‑register threshold of 70% lift>0 with median >2pp.
design.decision_rule: Reject null if ≥70% of matched units show lift>0 and median lift>2pp, after FDR correction; otherwise fail to reject.
